title: spider.output
description: Envelope returned by the `spider` MCP tool. stealth-cli emits TWO variants: success `{ok:true, operation:"spider", result:{...}}` and failure `{ok:false, operation:"spider", exit_code, error}`. Agents must branch on `ok` and pick the matching variant.

ok.description: True on success (envelope carries `result`). False on failure (envelope carries `exit_code` + `error` and no `result`).

operation.description: Operation tag echoed by the CLI. Always `spider` for this tool.

result.description: Success-only. Spider result payload. Shape varies by run mode (HTML extract, API discovery, adaptive relocate, CF-evaluate sidecar) but always includes a `session_id` and may include `recipe`, `api_response`, `relocate`, `cf`, `vpn_monitor` blocks. Absent on failure.

session_id.description: UUIDv4 correlating this spider call with downstream relocate/cf-evaluate calls. Always present on success.

recipe.description: SiteRecipe-shaped extraction payload when extraction succeeded.

api_response.description: Captured API response when the spider discovered an in-page XHR/Fetch endpoint.

relocate.description: Adaptive relocate result when `stable_id` was supplied.

vpn_monitor.description: VPN egress monitor block when `vpn=true`. Contains exit country, leak status, and rotation summary.

exit_code.description: Failure-only. CLI exit code (e.g. 7 = leak-detected, 1 = user error, 2 = transient, 3 = permanent). Absent on success.

error.description: Failure-only. Human-readable error message. Absent on success.

vpn_monitor.description: Failure-only (leak-shutdown branch, exit_code=7). VPN egress monitor snapshot captured at leak-detect time. emit_leak_exit attaches this block at the root of the failure envelope, NOT inside `result`. Absent on success and on non-leak failures.

_meta.description: P13.4: sanitize-pass metadata attached by stealth-mcp before this payload becomes LLM-visible. Always present; agents can ignore it unless inspecting prompt-injection telemetry. Shape stable per `stealth-sanitize::SanitizationReport` (schema_version=1).

sanitize.description: Resolved sanitize report. See `stealth_sanitize::SanitizationReport` for the canonical shape.
